title: Field-studies of earthquake-induced, liquefaction-flowage features in the Charleston, South Carolina, area:  preliminary report
citation: Gohn, G.S., Weems, R.E., Obermeier, S.F., and Gelinas, R.L., 1984, Field-studies of earthquake-induced, liquefaction-flowage features in the Charleston, South Carolina, area:  preliminary report: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-84-670, map scale 1:500,000.
notes: Paleoliquefaction field study at the Hollywood ditch (Wadmalaw quadrangle) and a site near the Charleston Airport. Host map units from McCartan and others (1984) are OCR-garbled on p.5 ('Q^', 'Q2') and the sediment ages' exponents are garbled (p.5, 22, 25), so no units or ages were recorded for them. Soil horizons of the typical Hollywood ditch profile are recorded as intervals of one outcrop; horizon thicknesses are given in descriptions because the source gives no depths for them. Page 26 (end of text and acknowledgments) is unreadable OCR. Non-SC references (Alaska, California, Australia, Youd) were skipped. Munsell 'SYR' is as printed (probably 5YR).
